correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the complex unit-circle vector z at alternating angular gaps 2u,2(α−u), with z⊥1 and squared edge chords K c, K d. Its Rayleigh quotient is exactly the budget-wide upper bound Γ for EVERY nonsymmetric allocation. Explicit a,b positive and m(ca+db)=1; Bloch two-vertex bands are a+b±sqrt(a²+b²+2ab cos(2πj/m)), with the k=1 lower band exactly Γ. Any other optimizer attains Rayleigh equality with fixed complex z, hence satisfies L(w)z=Γz; at every vertex two adjacent noncollinear circle chords imply each real conductance difference is zero. This proves uniqueness even at m=2; α→0 yields limiting inverse-square-root price ratio and m³Γ. Source numerical checker inspects 75 spectral/eigenvector instances, 600 nonsymmetric candidates and an exact C6 witness; finite numerics are corroborative.
